decision.application_rule: Only the v0.19.0 RTX 3090 native lane, compared with its published incumbent component named in incumbent_components; the RTX 4090 is carried unchanged at its published beta.3 and is not measured under this decision. Each admitted cross-engine difference requires an exact-lane, exact-incumbent/candidate passing EXP-085 verdict bound by repository_path and file SHA-256 in quality_screens. A0/A3 and B1/B2 must always remain byte-identical. No threshold override or speed waiver is granted.
decision.decision: v0.19.0 native speed decision, the founder rule carried over unchanged: floor 0.98 weighted / 0.95 per case; outputs may differ from the incumbent only on a lane with a bound passing EXP-085 verdict; within-engine determinism still required.
